title: Megawärme
lead: Two arches, two dots, a double M. Logo and pattern for renewable heat.

blocks.title: Origin
blocks.text: Megawärme plans and builds renewable heating and cooling for existing buildings. The brand needed to feel soft and approachable, and at the same time precise.

blocks.title: Concept & design decisions
blocks.text: The diameter of the dot is the module of the whole brand, and the mark is exactly five modules wide. Repeated, it becomes a pattern for business cards, the web and the building site.
